_what_this_is: Every image committed under visual/assets, with the sha256 of the bytes and the role those bytes play. brief.asset_manifest() reads it; brief.approved_portrait() refuses to hand out a face whose bytes do not match the approved_face entry; freeze.reference_paths() refuses any reference whose bytes do not match the frozen pack's reference_hashes. Roles: approved_face is the one face the owner approved on 2026-09-22 and the only committed asset a render may be conditioned on; superseded_body frames are the pre-revision body the owner replaced and are never a fallback reference; owner_concept is the owner's own generated concept, the direction the pack was built from, and not the model. MANIFEST v2 (2026-10-06, D-FB-11): `identity` names the canonical identity (Laura, laura-v15-a42aeac7); `assets` keeps the five top-level files brief.py reads, now with bytes/dimensions/provenance/forbidden_as_fallback; `library` lists the versioned canonical/ and historical/ frames under canonical/<identity_id>/; `missing_canonical` lists the frozen v15 frames whose bytes exist only in production; `not_committed_historical` records hashes of held frames deliberately left out. visual/canonical.py verifies all of it and tests/test_canon_manifest.py fails on any change.

identity.name: Laura
identity.what_she_is: Laura is a persistent AI person and the Founder/CEO of Brambleloop (D-FB-13; supersedes the narrower AI Brand & Customer Experience Director role of D-FB-12). The approved woman is her permanent visual identity and the canonical face of the company (D-FB-11). Her identity, memory, role and history persist independently of any underlying model. Publicly disclosed as an AI; never claimed to be biologically human; no fabricated human experiences. Permanent unless the human owner explicitly changes that decision.
identity.frozen_pack_candidate_fingerprint_source: production GET /api/model-identity/freezable, read 2026-10-06 (unauthenticated, read-only): the v15 build row
identity.pack_procedure_version_note: reference_pack.PACK_VERSION in code (currently v16-...) labels the pack-BUILD procedure, not her identity. The identity is the frozen v15 build. A newer procedure label never means a newer woman.
identity.identity_rule: An image depicting a woman similar to Laura is NOT Laura and fails the identity gate.
